name: You
text: Hey! You're back!

name: Wise Crow
text: Yeah, I thought I could use a little break

name: You
text: Have you gone into the portals yet?

name: Wise Crow
text: I did, how did those portals get there?

name: You
text: I don't know...

name: You
text: But I want to figure it out!

name: Wise Crow
text: Really?

name: Wise Crow
text: Well good luck on your hunt

name: You
text: Thanks!

name: Wise Crow
text: You know, I found this weird thing on the ground...

name: Wise Crow
text: I don't know what it is, but I'd be willing to give it to you

name: Wise Crow
text: But I uhh don't trust you with it yet

name: Wise Crow
text: If you can prove yourself capable enough...

name: Wise Crow
text: I'll give it to you!

name: Wise Crow
text: Let's see if you can travel 100,000ft!

name: You
text: 100,000 feet!? That's a lot...

name: Wise Crow
text: Feet? I didn't say anything about feet...

name: Wise Crow
text: ft is slang for french fries

name: You
text: What's up with the T then?

name: Wise Crow
text: I don't know, I didn't make the units of measurement

name: Wise Crow
text: I guess french fries is all we know

name: You
text: That's still alot of fries dude

name: Wise Crow
text: Well what if it's super powerful and cool

name: You
text: okay fine

name: You
text: I'll do it!

name: Wise Crow
text: Great!
